confirmed_task:
On arXiv, use Advanced Search to find cs.LG papers submitted within the last 30 days whose titles contain the exact phrase ‘mixture of experts’. Sort results newest first and report the three most recent papers with their arXiv IDs, titles, and first authors. Verify that every reported paper matches the category, date, and title filter.

Stopping condition: Stop after three matching papers and their filter checks have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Do not log in.
- Do not submit or modify any paper.
- Use the current date shown by the browser for the 30-day window.
